title: Hamas hands over the bodies of four hostages and Israel frees hundreds of Palestinian prisoners
body:
Early on 27 February 2025, Hamas handed the bodies of four hostages to the Red Cross in Gaza, according to the Associated Press. An Israeli security official confirmed the handover, and Israel said Egyptian mediators helped bring the caskets through an Israeli crossing. Identification of the remains began afterwards. In return, Israel released hundreds of Palestinian prisoners. A Red Cross convoy carried several dozen from Ofer prison to Beitunia in the West Bank, while buses carrying hundreds more reached Khan Younis in Gaza.

Israel had delayed the release of more than 600 prisoners since the previous Saturday, citing what it called the cruel treatment of hostages during an earlier Hamas handover. Hamas described the delay as a serious violation of the ceasefire. Palestinian officials' lists included 445 men, 21 teenagers and one woman, and dozens serving life sentences for deadly attacks on Israelis were to be exiled, at least temporarily, to Egypt.

The exchange came as the six-week first phase of the ceasefire that began on 19 January 2025 was due to expire. The Associated Press reported that during that phase Hamas returned 33 hostages, including eight bodies, in exchange for nearly 2,000 Palestinian prisoners. US envoy Steve Witkoff wanted talks to move to a second phase covering the release of all remaining hostages and an end to the war. The returned bodies included Shiri Bibas and her sons Kfir and Ariel. Israel says forensic evidence shows they were killed in captivity in November 2023, while Hamas says an Israeli airstrike killed them.
